imagePullSecrets.description: Global registry secret names as an array

releaseNameTelicentCore.description: Release name used during the Telicent Core chart installation. Note: ensure the value is correct, otherwise there will be no access to auth & graph

appHostDomain.description: Domain associated with Telicent application/ui services. This value cannot be changed after it is set

apiHostDomain.description: Domain associated with Telicent Api services. This value cannot be changed after it is set

authHostDomain.description: Domain associated with Telicent authentication services, including OIDC providers. This value cannot be changed after it is set

existingEnvConfigMap.description: Name of existing configmap containing *AI Sparql Builder* Environment Configuration

enabled.description: Enable or disable the *AI Sparql Builder* component

nameOverride.description: String to partially override fullname (will maintain the release name)

fullnameOverride.description: String to fully override the generated release name

namespaceOverride.description: String to fully override all deployed resources namespace

commonLabels.description: Add labels to all the deployed resources

replicas.description: Number of *AI Sparql Builder* replicas to deploy

revisionHistoryLimit.description: Number of controller revisions to keep

annotations.description: Add extra annotations to the deployment object

podLabels.description: Add extra labels to the *AI Sparql Builder* pod

podAnnotations.description: Add extra annotations to the *AI Sparql Builder* pod

extraEnvVars.description: Array with extra environment variables to add to *AI Sparql Builder* pod

extraVolumes.description: Optionally specify extra list of additional volumes

extraVolumeMounts.description: Optionally specify extra list of additional volumeMounts

initContainers.description: Add init containers to the pod

tag.description: *AI Sparql Builder* image tag. If not set, a tag is generated using the appVersion

pullSecrets.description: Specify registry secret names as an array

CHATBOT_SPARQL_URL.description: URL of the SPARQL endpoint to query for the chatbot

CHATBOT_AUTH_SERVER_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public URL of the authentication server, used for OIDC discovery and token validation

CHATBOT_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.description: OAuth client ID registered in the authentication server for the chatbot application

AUTH_SERVER_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of the authentication server, used for obtaining tokens. This may differ from CHATBOT_AUTH_SERVER_PUBLIC_URL if the auth server is behind a proxy or has different internal/external URLs

AUTH_SERVER_ALLOW_HTTP.description: Whether to allow HTTP connections to the authentication server (true/false). Should be set to true for local development with port-forwarding, and false for production deployments with secure connections

JWT_ISSUER.description: Expected JWT issuer claim for validating tokens. Should match the issuer configured in the authentication server for the chatbot's OAuth client.

CHATBOT_LLM_PROVIDER.description: The LLM provider to use for the chatbot. Supported values: transformers.

CHATBOT_PROMPT_VARIANT.description: The prompt variant to use for the chatbot. Supported values: training, production. The 'training' variant includes additional context and examples in the prompt to improve response quality, while the 'production' variant uses a more concise prompt for faster responses.

CHATBOT_TRANSFORMERS_MODEL_PATH.description: The file system path where the chatbot's Transformers models are stored. This should match the path used in the chatbot application code to load the models. In this example, it is set to '/app/models', which means the models should be mounted or copied to that path in the container.

CHATBOT_SPARQL_DATASET.description: The name of the dataset to use in the SPARQL endpoint for the chatbot queries. This should match the dataset name configured in the SPARQL endpoint that contains the relevant data for the chatbot.

runAsUser.description: Set the provisioning pod's Security Context runAsUser User ID

runAsGroup.description: Set the provisioning pod's Security Context runAsGroup Group ID

runAsNonRoot.description: Set the provisioning pod's Security Context runAsNonRoot

fsGroup.description: Set the provisioning pod's Group ID for the mounted volumes' filesystem

type.description: Set the provisioning pod's Security Context seccomp profile

runAsUser.description: Set containers' Security Context runAsUser User ID

runAsGroup.description: Set containers' Security Context runAsGroup Group ID

drop.description: List of capabilities to be dropped

type.description: Set container's Security Context seccomp profile

enabled.description: Enable GPU support for the AI Sparql Builder

type.description: The GPU resource type to request (e.g. nvidia.com/gpu, amd.com/gpu)

runtimeClassName.description: Set the runtimeClassName for the pod (e.g. nvidia for NVIDIA GPU Operator). Leave empty to use the cluster default

tolerations.description: key for toleration to allow scheduling on GPU nodes

key.description: key for toleration to allow scheduling on GPU nodes

operator.description: operator for the toleration to allow scheduling on GPU nodes

effect.description: effect for the toleration to allow scheduling on GPU nodes

labelKey.description: Node label key used to identify GPU nodes

operator.description: Operator for the label expression (In, Exists, etc.)

values.description: Label values to match for GPU node selection. Only used when operator is 'In'

create.description: Specifies whether a service account should be created

name.description: Name of the ServiceAccount to use. If not set, a name is generated using the fullname

annotations.description: Additional custom annotations for the ServiceAccount

automount.description: Automatically mount a ServiceAccount's API credentials

name.description: *AI Sparql Builder* service name. If not set, a name is generated using the fullname

enableAutoCorrect.description: Prefix 'global.releaseNameTelicentCore' value to each host value. Alternatively, the host value will be used as it is, without any modification

traefikProxy.description: Traefik Proxy application default host value, as defined by 'service/serviceAccount:port'

auth.description: Auth application default host value, as defined by 'service/serviceAccount:port'

graph.description: Graph application host value, as defined by 'service/serviceAccount:port'
